messages.content: what are the thin pfg shirts called

message.content:
The thin Columbia PFG shirts are generally called **PFG fishing shirts** or **Performance Fishing Gear shirts**.[1][7]

If you mean the lightweight, breathable short-sleeve ones, Columbia’s product line includes styles like **Bahama**, while other thin options include **Terminal Tackle** and **Tidal Deflector** shirts.[1][2]
